reviewer: single_header (independent of harness and build authors)

reviewed_changes.assessment: Seven added contracts exercise the real Make rules using isolated temporary registration entries, timestamp ordering and executable shell fixtures. They preserve missing-source failure, registration/header invalidation, explicit C++23 selection, and mandatory versus optional exit 77.
The CUDA route now passes the selected CUDA_PATH to Clang with --cuda-path, in addition to the existing runtime link search path. Other backend flags are unchanged.
SYCL queue construction explicitly selects a GPU and rethrows asynchronous exceptions. Stdout capture restores the descriptor and closes its temporary stream before propagating failures.
GPU fallback is rejected and submitted work is waited on with wait_and_throw. Exception paths return failure with a diagnostic.
An explicit mapped target preflight rejects execution on the initial device before comparing output. Host fallback can no longer produce a misleading accelerator success.

limitations: This supplement reviews source and runs compiler-free infrastructure checks. The allocated backend job records actual compiler results separately.
No hardware execution is implied by this review.
